title: SupportTicketAnalysis
description: Structured analysis of a technical support ticket. Factual slots are confirmed or unknown only. Troubleshooting and escalation are placeholders until product documentation is connected.

summary.description: Concise summary of the issue, using only confirmed facts.

rationale.description: Brief explanation of the selected classification and priority, grounded in confirmed facts and unknown slots.

environment.description: Deployment environment stated in the ticket (e.g. Production).

application.description: Application or product area stated in the ticket.

error_messages.description: Exact error messages quoted from the ticket.

object_ids.description: Relevant object IDs stated in the ticket (e.g. assessment, business partner).

missing_information.description: Questions for the customer, driven by unknown fact slots and other gaps. May be empty.

const: This field will be filled when this tool has access to the product documentation.
troubleshooting_steps.description: Placeholder until product documentation is connected. The model must not invent troubleshooting steps.

draft_response.description: Draft reply that could be sent to the customer.

escalate_to_development.description: Escalation is not proposed until product documentation is connected.

escalation_reason.const: This field will be filled when this tool has access to the product documentation.
escalation_reason.description: Placeholder until product documentation is connected. The model must not invent an escalation recommendation.
